map.出示字母或数字及其镜像，让孩子判断右侧是否为镜像写法的练习游戏，训练视觉空间辨识: A practice game that shows a letter or digit and its mirror image, asking children to judge whether the right one is the mirrored form, training visuospatial discrimination and left-right distinction, often used to prevent writing reversals in young children (such as confusing b and d).
map.低龄儿童常把左右镜像字母写反，做对照练习。: Young children often write mirrored letters left-right reversed, so do comparison drills.
map.用基准线法区分易混字形。: Use the baseline method to distinguish easily confused letter shapes.
map.b 与 d 怎么分: How are b and d distinguished?
map.：以竖线为身体基准：b 是「身子+肚子在右」(圈在右)，d 是「圈在左」；口诀「: : take the vertical line as the body reference: b is "body with belly on the right" (bowl on the right), d is "bowl on the left"; the mnemonic is "b draws the stem first then the bowl on the right, d draws the bowl on the left first then the stem".
map.：p 圈在右、竖向下出头；q 圈在左、竖向下出头。对比 b(竖向上)/d(竖向上: : p has its bowl on the right with the stem descending below the line; q has its bowl on the left with the stem descending below the line. Compare with b (stem ascending) and d (stem ascending): the four are located on two dimensions, bowl left/right plus stem up/down.
map.学龄前常见、多随发育缓解；若一年级后仍频繁反写，用描红+基准线+多感官(描沙)练: Common before school age and usually resolves with development; if reversals are still frequent after first grade, use tracing with baseline guides plus multisensory (sand tracing) practice, and avoid negative labeling.
